Description: As a user, I want to create a habit by providing a name, category, target frequency, and optional description, so that I can start tracking my daily progress.
As a user, I want to edit an existing habit's name, category, target frequency, and description, so that I can adjust my tracking as needed.
As a user, I want to delete an existing habit, so that I can remove habits I no longer want to track.
As a user, I want to prevent creating two habits with the same name, so that I can avoid confusion and errors.

Summary: Ensure habit names are not empty
Description: As a user, I want habit names to be non-empty, so that I can clearly identify my habits.
As a user, I want to mark a habit as completed for the current day, so that I can track my progress.
As a user, I want to undo today's completion if it was recorded by mistake, so that I can correct any errors.

Summary: Prevent multiple completions on the same day
Description: As a user, I want to prevent marking a habit as completed more than once on the same day, so that I can accurately track my progress.
As a user, I want the application to automatically record the completion date, so that I don't have to manually enter it.
As a user, I want the application to calculate my current streak, so that I can see how many consecutive days I have completed a habit.
As a user, I want the application to calculate my longest streak, so that I can see the highest number of consecutive days I have completed a habit.
As a user, I want the application to calculate the total number of times I have completed a habit, so that I can see my overall progress.
As a user, I want the application to calculate the completion rate, so that I can see the percentage of days I have completed a habit.
As a user, I want the dashboard to display the total number of active habits, so that I can see how many habits I am currently tracking.
As a user, I want the dashboard to display the number of habits I have completed today, so that I can see my progress for the day.
As a user, I want the dashboard to display the number of habits I have missed today, so that I can see areas where I need improvement.
As a user, I want the dashboard to display the best current streak, so that I can see my highest streak.
As a user, I want the statistics to update immediately after any change, so that I can see the most up-to-date information.

Summary: View calendar showing completed and missed days
Description: As a user, I want to view a calendar showing completed and missed days for each habit, so that I can see my progress over time.
As a user, I want past records to remain available even after editing a habit's description or category, so that I can review my history.
As a user, I want to restrict editing of completion records older than seven days, so that I can maintain accurate historical data.
As a user, I want to configure a daily reminder time, so that I don't forget to complete my habits.
As a user, I want the application to display a reminder notification at the configured time, so that I don't forget to complete my habits.
As a user, I want to disable notifications if I don't want to be reminded, so that I can focus on my habits without interruptions.
As a user, I want the reminder time change to apply immediately, so that I can set a new reminder time without waiting for the next day.
As a user, I want all data to be stored locally, so that it remains available after restarting the application.
As a user, I want the application to recover previously saved data automatically when launched, so that I don't lose any progress.
As a user, I want the application to handle failed operations without leaving data in an inconsistent state, so that I can continue using the application without issues.
As a user, I want the application to include separate sections for Dashboard, Habits, Calendar, Statistics, and Settings, so that I can easily access different features.
As a user, I want successful operations to display confirmation messages, so that I know my actions have been completed.
As a user, I want validation errors to clearly explain what went wrong, so that I can correct any issues.
